    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActionType
    Enumeration of all possible player actions in the game.
    Bot
    Abstract base class for all bot players.
    Card
    Abstract base class for all cards in the game.
    CardChoice
    Represents a card choice, either from the visible market or from a player's reserved hand.
    CardMarket
    Represents the card market in the game.
    ClientHandler
    Handles communication between the server and a single client.
    ClientInputHandler
    Handles all client-side input prompts for the Splendor multiplayer game.
    Cost
    Represents the gem cost required to obtain a card.
    DevelopmentCard
    Represents a development card in the game.
    DisplayUI
    Handles all display output for the Splendor game.
    EasyBot
    A simple bot that uses basic heuristics: buy cheap preferred-color cards, collect gems toward visible targets, and reserve when nothing else is useful.
    GameActions
    Utility class containing static methods that execute player actions (taking gems, purchasing cards, reserving cards) and modify game state.
    GameConfig
    Stores configuration settings for the game.
    GameEngine
    Controls the main flow of the Splendor game.
    GameRules
    The GameRules class contains the logic that enforces the rules of the game.
    GameState
    The GameState class represents the current state of the game.
    GemCollection
    This represents a collection of gems and their quantities.
    GemColor
    Represents the different types of gem colors available in the game.
    HardBot
    An advanced bot that uses scoring heuristics including card points, noble synergy, opponent denial, tier penalties, and strategic gem collection.
    InputHandler
    Handles all user input prompts for the Splendor game.
    InvalidFileException
    Exception thrown when there is an issue with reading or processing a file.
    InvalidIndexException
    Exception thrown when an invalid index is used.
    Noble
    Represents a noble title in the game.
    Player
    This represents a player in the game.
    ServerBotHandler
    Handles automatic execution of bot turns on the server side.
    ServerHelper
    Centralizes all server-side message handling, broadcasting, and game action processing.
    ServerInputHandler
    Handles server-side validation and execution of player game actions (taking gems, purchasing cards, reserving cards).
    ServerListener
    Listens for messages from the server and processes them on the client side.
    SplendorClient
    The Splendor game client that connects to a server over sockets.
    SplendorServer
    The main Splendor game server.
    UnavailableCardException
    Exception thrown when a requested card is not available.
